companion_skills.description: Explicit list of skill ids that pair with this agent. Overrides name-stripping convention. Set to [] to declare intentional no-pair.

execution_tier.description: Trust posture: static-review (no Bash), read-only-runtime (allowlisted Bash, no mutation), mutating-runtime (changes external state).

lifecycle.description: Stability stage. Defaults to 'stable' when absent.

harness_variants.description: Per-harness adapter file paths. Keys are harness ids (claude-code, cursor, codex, copilot, gemini, kiro-cli, kiro-ide).

risk_tier.description: Enterprise trust tier. L3 agents can influence production, credentials, spend, or external effects and require explicit gates.

data_classes.description: Data classes the agent may handle when used as intended.

tool_permissions.description: Machine-readable permission summary for filesystem, shell, network, secrets, and external tools.

network_egress.description: Default network posture and explicitly allowed egress conditions.

approval_gates.description: Human approval gates required before risky operations.

agent_identity_mode.description: Identity mode expected when the agent is executed.

audit_events.description: Recommended audit event names emitted or recorded by compatible runtimes.

control_mappings.description: Control family identifiers supported by this agent's guardrails.

evidence_links.description: Local or URL evidence links for trust, eval, or source posture.
